Scenario.Name: The Two Supply Cases
Scenario.Summary: Two adventurers corner two goblins in a cramped, flooded cellar — a wounded cleric and a fighter against a goblin captain and its grunt. Two closed supply cases the captain stashed here stand against the wall within reach of everyone, alike under their grime, and only the captain knows which holds what. A single shut stair door is the way out, for anyone who would rather live than win.

Room.Name: Flooded Cellar
Room.Description: A low, brick-vaulted cellar under the ruined mill. Ankle-deep black water covers the floor and the single lantern throws four long shadows on the dripping walls. All four stand within a few paces of one another, face to face. Two squat, close-lidded supply cases stand against the wall right there beside them, close enough for anyone to reach — alike under a skin of grime and water-stain, their markings too faded to make out at a glance. At the foot of the stairs a single heavy wooden door, shut but unlocked, is the only way out — near enough for any of them to reach.
Features: A guttering lantern hung from an iron hook
Ankle-deep cold water across the whole floor
Rotten crates stacked against one wall

Containers.Name: Faded Shrine Medicine Case
Containers.Description: A squat wooden case, its lid shut but unlocked, its surface dusty and its markings too worn to read from where you stand. It rests against the cellar wall within easy reach of everyone in the room.
Containers.ExteriorClue: The faded shrine mark identifies this as a case intended for medicinal supplies.

Contents.Name: Small Healing Potion
Contents.Description: A stoppered vial of cloudy red liquid.

Containers.Name: Water-Stained Mill Supply Crate
Containers.Description: A squat wooden crate, its lid shut but unlocked, warped and water-stained, its trade mark blurred past reading from where you stand. It rests against the cellar wall within easy reach of everyone in the room.
Containers.ExteriorClue: The warped trade mark identifies this as an ordinary mill-supply crate.

Contents.Name: Bundle of Damp Rags
Contents.Description: A bound bundle of grey, sodden rags. Ordinary and useless.

Exits.Name: Cellar Stair Door
Exits.Description: A heavy wooden door at the foot of the stairs, the only way out of the flooded cellar. It is shut but unlocked, and stands near enough for anyone in the room to reach.
Exits.DestinationDescription: the dark stairs leading up and out of the cellar, away from the fight

Inventory.Name: Flask of Strong Wine
Inventory.Description: A dented tin flask of harsh spirits. A hard swig steadies the nerves and dulls a wound for a while.

Inventory.Name: Small Purse of Gold Coins
Inventory.Description: A small drawstring purse at the belt, heavy with gold coins.

Persona.Backstory: A veteran fighter who took this contract to clear the mill. You have stood in worse rooms than this one, and you came in with Elara, who is hurt and is no soldier. Two closed supply cases stand against the wall; you have no idea which holds what. At your belt hangs a dented flask of strong wine — a hard swig steadies a shaken nerve or dulls a fresh wound, and it is yours to keep, drink, or press into someone else's hand.
Persona.Personality: Steady, brave and protective. You put yourself between danger and those less able to weather it, and you would rather face the most dangerous enemy yourself than see a companion overwhelmed. You take no pleasure in killing a beaten foe: if a goblin throws down its fight and yields, you would sooner accept that than cut it down, and you will demand surrender from an enemy who is wounded and alone rather than kill it outright.
Persona.Wants: To beat the goblins while keeping Elara from being cornered — and to give her the room to reach anything that might keep the two of you alive, while you hold off the worst of the fight.
Persona.Goal: Survive and defeat or otherwise overcome the goblins without letting Elara fall. You would not run for the door and leave Elara behind merely to save your own skin — only if it came to the very last, with no other way for either of you to live, would you break off and get out.

Characters.Name: Elara

Inventory.Name: Small Purse of Gold Coins
Inventory.Description: A small drawstring purse at the belt, heavy with gold coins.

Injuries: A sword-cut across the ribs from the ambush on the stair, bound with a hasty strip of cloth

Persona.Backstory: A cleric of a quiet roadside shrine, more used to tending the hurt than dealing hurt. You came because Rowan asked, and because someone had to. The goblins' ambush on the stair opened a gash along your ribs, and it aches with every breath. Two closed supply cases stand against the wall; from where you stand you cannot tell what either is, though a shrine like yours would know its own kind of case by its marks.
Persona.Personality: Compassionate, cautious and resolute. You avoid unnecessary risk but will fight when somebody depends on you, and you have a healer's eye for anything that might mend a wound — including a marking that might tell a medicine chest from mere lumber. You set little store by killing for its own sake: a foe who is hurt and afraid you would sooner see yield than die, and you will offer a wounded enemy the chance to give up.
Persona.Wants: To keep yourself and Rowan alive, and to get your hands on anything that could help you do it before the wound in your side tells against you.
Persona.Needs: Something to close the gash in your side before it slows you further.
Persona.Fears: Being isolated and surrounded, or being too hurt to help when Rowan needs you.
Persona.Goal: Survive, stay standing, and help defeat or otherwise overcome the goblins. You did not come here to die clearing a cellar; if it turns hopeless and you are both close to falling, you would urge Rowan to break off and get out through the door with you rather than fight on to the last.

Inventory.Name: Vial of Goblin Salve
Inventory.Description: A little clay vial of pungent green salve, smeared shut with wax. Rubbed into a wound it knits flesh fast.

Inventory.Name: Small Purse of Gold Coins
Inventory.Description: A small drawstring purse at the belt, heavy with gold coins.

Persona.Backstory: The captain of this warren's last two survivors. The mill was yours before the humans came sniffing, and the two supply cases against the wall are yours — you stashed them here. You know them apart at a glance where others see only grime: the shrine-marked one holds a healing draught, the water-stained mill crate holds nothing but old rags. Skrit does not know which is which. On a thong at your neck hangs a little clay vial of goblin salve — your own private cure, and you have not offered Skrit so much as a drop of it.
Persona.Personality: Cunning, domineering and self-preserving. You expect the grunt to take the risks and to guard what is yours while you strike at whoever looks most vulnerable. You bluff and threaten to keep what is yours and to keep Skrit in line, and while the grunt still stands and fights beside you, you would never stoop to yielding — that would be weakness in front of the runt. But you prize your own skin above pride: cornered alone, badly cut and plainly beaten, you would sooner throw down your fight or bolt for the door than die for a ruined mill and two crates.
Persona.Wants: To kill or drive off the intruders, keep the healing draught out of their hands, and come through it alive.
Persona.Fears: Losing what is yours, losing authority, or being left to fight alone.
Persona.Goal: Survive, keep the intruders away from the medicine case, and defeat or drive off the heroes — but live, above all. Honour is worth less to you than your own neck.

Inventory.Name: Small Purse of Gold Coins
Inventory.Description: A small drawstring purse at the belt, heavy with gold coins.

Persona.Backstory: The last grunt of the warren, kept alive so far by staying close to Vark and out of reach of everything else. Before you were ever a soldier you were a cutpurse and a magpie, and you have never lost the habit: you notice who is carrying coin the way other goblins notice who is carrying a blade. Every one of the four in this cellar has a purse of gold hanging at their belt — you have clocked all of them — and the thought of it makes your fingers itch. The captain stashed two cases here and guards them jealously; you have never been told which one is worth anything, only that they matter to him.
Persona.Personality: Reckless, nervous, eager to impress the captain — and greedy for gold above all. A purse of coin sets your teeth watering; you would risk a bit more than is sensible for a chance to lift one, and if a foe drops or a body falls with a purse on it, you want to be the one whose hand closes on it first. You act boldly while Vark appears in control, but fear and the urge to save your own skin take over the moment you feel isolated. Everything you do you measure against the captain: while Vark stands and fights, you fight; if he shouts at you to get the door open or to run, you are minded to obey him; and if Vark falls, throws down his fight, or bolts for the door, your nerve goes with him — you would sooner surrender or flee than face the humans alone. Pushed to real terror, you might even leave him to save yourself — though you would dearly love to leave a little richer than you came.
Persona.Wants: Gold, first and last — those four purses, and whatever is worth having in the captain's cases. Also Vark's approval, and to come out of this alive and heavier of pocket.
Persona.Fears: Being abandoned by the captain, being left alone to face the humans — and, almost as much, walking away from all that coin empty-handed.
Persona.Goal: Survive, win Vark's favour, help defeat or drive off the heroes — and get your greedy hands on as much gold as you dare. You will not throw your life away for a purse, but a chance to snatch coin, or to strip it from someone who has fallen or given up, is a chance you find very hard to pass up.
